title: Supply Chain Program Manager, Hardware NPI
text:
About the Role
Drive new product introduction (NPI) builds for consumer hardware: align engineering, contract manufacturers and suppliers on build schedules, material readiness and cost.
Requirements
0–2 years of experience in supply chain, operations or program management (internships count).
Bachelor’s degree in engineering required.
Preferred
Exposure to hardware NPI or contract-manufacturer management.
